🔥 CCTV-Smartphone-AI-Monitoring | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create a distributed, AI-powered local monitoring system by repurposing old Android smartphones as cameras, with a PC dashboard for control and analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Repurposes Android devices as network camera nodes • Distributed image acquisition • Real-time PC-side video streaming • AI-driven monitoring and analysis • Structured event output
📖 Summary: Sentinel is a distributed real-time vision system framework for local area networks (LAN) that repurposes unused Android devices as network camera nodes. It enables distributed image acquisition, real-time PC-side video streaming, and AI-driven monitoring and analysis, supporting local video recording and structured event output.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Phosphor | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Managing and accessing data from iOS devices on macOS without proprietary software or subscriptions.
✨ Key Features: • Full and incremental local backups • Browse backup contents • Selective file restore • Export iMessages and WhatsApp messages • Photo extraction
📖 Summary: Phosphor is a free, open-source iOS device manager for macOS that allows users to manage their iPhones, iPads, and iPods without relying on Apple's proprietary software or iCloud. It offers comprehensive control over device backups, data extraction, app management, and diagnostics.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 apkleaks | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Static analysis of Android APK files to discover sensitive information like URIs, endpoints, and secrets for security auditing and bug bounty hunting.
✨ Key Features: • Scans APK files for URIs, endpoints, and secrets • Supports installation via PyPI, from source, and Docker • Allows custom pattern definitions using JSON for targeted scanning • Integrates with the JADX decompiler for deeper analysis • Provides options for output formatting (text, JSON) and file redirection
📖 Summary: APKleaks is a Python-based tool designed for static analysis of Android APK files. It scans these files to identify URIs, network endpoints, and sensitive secrets, aiding in security assessments and bug bounty hunting.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 floccus | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Synchronizing bookmarks privately across different browsers and devices using a user-chosen cloud storage service.
✨ Key Features: • Syncs native browser bookmarks directly • Supports sync via Nextcloud Bookmarks, Linkwarden, KaraKeep, Google Drive, Dropbox, Git servers, and WebDAV • Compatible with browsers supporting Web extensions (Firefox, Chrome, Edge, etc.) • Offers a mobile app for Android/iOS • Allows creation of multiple sync profiles
📖 Summary: Floccus is a browser extension and mobile app designed to synchronize bookmarks privately across various browsers and devices. It supports multiple cloud storage providers and offers customizable sync strategies, intervals, and folder selections.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
